## Outcome and dependencies

Establish whether the existing Broodling Python boundary composes with the released Zeroshot standard workflow and a configured DirectTarget to produce an **actual authorized GitHub PR**, a matching stable receipt, and durable Broodling disposition. Retain a boundary PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED result; this is not a real-provider quality or release verdict.

**Parent:** #62. **Depends on:** #63's current frozen protocol, [`p5-native-pr-v2`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f/evaluation/p5/v2/protocol.md) at `1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f`, a supported default-suite baseline, and satisfied/current live prerequisites and explicit repository/effect/run/spend authorization bound to that freeze commit. A completed protocol with blocked preflight does not permit dispatch. Successful boundary evidence is required before the bounded quality campaign; failed or blocked evidence can go directly to skeptical review without forcing more runs.

## Authority and source basis

Follow [docs/governing/current.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/docs/governing/current.md), #62 and #63 under that authority, including the prospective v2 amendment made before any live result, then current production code and [tests/README.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/tests/README.md). Backlog inspection used `b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068`.

The relevant existing seams are [submission.py](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/broodling/submission.py), [zeroshot_sdk.py](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/broodling/zeroshot_sdk.py) and [disposition.py](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/broodling/disposition.py). [test_workflow_result.py](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/tests/test_workflow_result.py) already covers synthetic PR receipts, lifecycle/result negatives and real-native controlled-provider no-effect refusal. That is useful seam evidence, not an executed live PR handoff. The native integration and result-handoff audits explain the adopted DirectTarget/source/receipt boundary.

## Work and completion criteria

- Exercise one traceable supported vertical slice through existing admission/provisioning, `SubmissionCoordinator` and `WorkUnitDispositionCoordinator` entrypoints: entitled sources and a criteria-only Contract with exactly one authorized `pull_request` effect; original B1 and exclusive local worktree; immutable invocation and durable dispatch/run correlation; native PR delivery on the authorized DirectTarget; matching receipt and atomic retained disposition. Let Zeroshot own its execution checkout, implementation, review, repair, commit/push and PR creation/update.
- Independently read the disposable repository's actual PR and exact commit to corroborate receipt repository, target branch, PR identity and non-B1 `headRevision`. Retain enough exact-revision material for later reproduction before disposable infrastructure is removed. This is evaluation evidence, not a new product custody service. Do not substitute the synthetic Attempt branch for the authorized PR base, manually publish a PR to manufacture success, or judge only a moving branch tip. An opened PR does not establish passing CI or merge readiness.
- Demonstrate caller detachment/reconnection using the persisted run locator, including consuming an already-completed result before first disposition, then reopening the Broodling store and rereading the identical retained result/disposition. No new execution or current dispatch credentials/profile should be required merely to consume the correlated result. Caller reconnection is not native-controller resurrection. Use the existing deterministic tests for acknowledgement-loss/conflicts, invalid/foreign receipts, currentness, atomic write failure, late success after abandonment, and safe undispatched replacement instead of expanding live fault permutations.
- Retain the existing no-effect/null-result refusal and dispatched cleanup/replacement refusal as explicit controlled claims. Show that the live dispatched Attempt remains ineligible for product cleanup/replacement, and record the operational retention/teardown consequences. No terminal result or operator host teardown may be turned into Broodling cleanup authority.

Use **R01**, the single boundary slot preregistered in `p5-native-pr-v2`; it is also the first quality observation and counts once. Live SDK/DirectTarget/GitHub delivery and the receipt must be real. **No provider substitution, replacement run, extra boundary run or rerun-until-green is authorized by v2.** R01 can enter the later quality accounting only under the frozen real-provider and independent-judging conditions.

## Evidence to retain

Retain the protocol/baseline version; source snapshots, original B1, immutable Contract and authorized effect; Attempt/workspace/submission-key/run identities and frozen invocation; sanitized target/provider configuration and authorization references; native result and complete receipt; PR/commit readback; Broodling durable correlation/result/disposition and reconnect observations; exact commands, expected/actual outcomes and existing-test references; every attempted run, failure, substitution and quarantine consequence. Keep evidence durable outside disposable workspaces and omit secrets.

A report may honestly record FAIL/BLOCKED. Successful completion of the boundary claim requires actual authorized delivery and retained matching disposition; green controlled tests or a fabricated receipt cannot substitute. Keep a failed/blocked report distinct from permission to start the quality campaign.

## Permitted changes and stop boundary

May add the minimal evaluation-only driver, supporting offline checks, reproduction instructions and new evidence records; operate only the explicitly authorized disposable evaluation resources. Do not change production behavior, schema, dependencies, runtime selection or existing invariant tests to obtain a pass. A concrete product defect gets its reproducer and a separately justified fix; freeze the resulting baseline and affected validation before later measured runs, preserving failed evidence.

Stop on missing authorization/infrastructure, exhausted limits, unsafe target conditions, or a blocking boundary defect. Do not compensate with another generic cleanup phase, custom graph/evidence/adjudicator/final-assessor/supervisor, no-effect snapshot fallback, automatic dispatched retry, broader effects, merge, packaging or tuning. Stop after the boundary report; do not launch the quality campaign here. **Planning item only at creation; not started.**
title: [P5] Validate the live authorized-PR product boundary
